story.object: P = ℝᵐ for m outputs with metric Σ⁻¹; for a continuously indexed output with a stated inner product, a function space (L²). Not the parameter space Θ.
story.established: TMS 2010/2011 (data space); finite metric in function space: g_ij = 2/(θᵢ + θⱼ)³ (MMIh)
story.connection: "infinite prediction space" is exact as a function space (T-PREDICTION-INFINITE)
story.hypothesis: the larger space carries structure that one projection does not show (Interactive Master Map, Stage IV)
story.extension: not a quantum state space; not physical spacetime
story.falsify: none for the definition; the infinite reading needs a stated inner product

story.object: M = Y(Θ) ⊆ P; dimension = rank J where J has constant rank; induced metric g = JᵀΣ⁻¹J
story.connection: "allowable manifold": the set of predictions the rules permit
story.hypothesis: rules constrain a geometry of allowed states (T-RULES-GEOMETRY, open)

story.idea: Parameters vs model rule vs image
story.object: model rule Y (functional form); parameter domain Θ; parameter values θ (coordinates on M); image M = Y(Θ). A reparametrization is a chart change (R1); M is unchanged
story.connection: "the rules of the manifold were the model parameters." Unpacked: Y and Θ fix M; θ is a point coordinate; the domain's limits are M's boundaries (T-MM-RULES, DERIVED)
story.hypothesis: governing rules play a broader role in allowable geometry (T-MM-RULES-Q)
story.falsify: a feature of M that depends on the chart would contradict the unpacking (none: MMIa, MMIf)

story.object: g = JᵀΣ⁻¹J, a symmetric (0,2)-tensor on Θ: the pullback of the prediction-space metric. Components transform g_φ = Jᵀ g J (R1); an isometry F*g = g (R2) exists only when the system supplies it
story.connection: placed in the Transformation Architecture: reparametrizations R1, isometries R2 (TA0)
story.falsify: a reparametrization reported as "g unchanged" (false for components)

story.object: g(v, v) = 0 ⟺ Jv = 0 ⟺ gv = 0 (g = JᵀΣ⁻¹J, Σ SPD). Kept apart: sloppy (λ small, nonzero), Lorentz null (vᵀηv = 0, ηv ≠ 0), bilinear null (B(u, v) = 0, u, v ≠ 0), collapsed zero (Φ(x) = 0, x ≠ 0)
story.connection: "a zero geometric length can expose hidden non-identifiability / redundancy." (T-ZERO-LENGTH, DERIVED); survives charts (CFT5d) and noise models (MMIe)
story.extension: observable zero does not uniquely specify underlying state (T-QUANTUM-ZERO): a STRUCTURAL ANALOGUE, no map given
story.falsify: a zero-length direction along which predictions change (impossible for SPD Σ)

story.object: small nonzero eigenvalues of g in a stated chart; the raw spectrum is chart-dependent (MMIb, CFT5e). Invariant versions: widths (row hyperribbon-widths) or generalized eigenvalues of g relative to a system-supplied tensor h
story.established: Gutenkunst et al. 2007; TMS 2010; S14b (weak); S14a FAIL kept
story.connection: M1 restated: the spectrum is a statement in log-parameter coordinates
story.falsify: already weakened: raw eigenvalues are not geometric invariants (NEGATIVE result for any raw-spectrum comparison)

story.object: cross-sectional extents of the image set M in (P, Σ⁻¹), measured along geodesics (TMS 2011); bounded by a hyperellipsoid whose widths decay geometrically for analytic models (Chebyshev, Quinn et al. 2019). Parametrization-independent, metric-dependent (MMIf)
story.connection: the recommended C7 target object (T-C7 gate)
story.hypothesis: C7: a structural relation between coefficient decay and model-manifold geometry (T-C7, OPEN)
story.falsify: a width definition that changes with the chart (would contradict MMIf); the C7 residue reducing to Quinn 2019 (then VALIDATION OF KNOWN MATHEMATICS)

story.object: limits Y(θ) as θ → ∂Θ: lower-dimensional faces of M; the limit set is chart-independent, the approach rate is not; the dimension drops (rank 2 → 1, MMIg)
story.connection: simpler structure as a boundary of a richer model (T-SIMPLER-BOUNDARY-Q)
story.falsify: a boundary that depends on the chart (none: MMIg)

story.object: the boundary model (e.g. e^{−θ₁t}); MBAM reaches it along a geodesic. In the Reduction architecture a limit is a degeneration of the family, not a map Φ: X → Y on states

story.hypothesis: effective representations follow a general law (H6, OPEN)
